title: Settings

subtitle.full: What lanstash does, changed here; where it listens and what it stores stay in its configuration file

signIn: Shown only: changing settings needs an account that may change them

row.resetLabel: Reset {{label}} to the config file's value

auto_update.label: Automatic updates
auto_update.help: Games once held whole are queued for their new builds: always, in a daily window (HH:MM-HH:MM, UTC), or off.

prefill_parallel.label: Prefill requests at once
prefill_parallel.help: How many requests a prefill keeps in flight (1 to 64).

steam_os.label: Operating system
steam_os.help: Who a Steam install is for: prefills, builds and sizes follow it.

steam_language.label: Languages
steam_language.help: The languages your PCs play in: an install takes each one's files, so none is fetched from the internet.

blizzard_region.label: Region
blizzard_region.help: The region whose current builds count.

blizzard_tags.label: Install tags
blizzard_tags.help: What a Battle.net install is (platform, architecture, locale, optional content), comma-separated.

max_size.label: Size limit
max_size.help: The most the stash may hold (8000G, 2T); eviction makes room beyond it. Empty: no limit.

keep_free.label: Keep free
keep_free.help: Space eviction keeps free on the disk (30%, 500G).

verify_every.label: Check stored bytes
verify_every.help: Reads every stored byte against its checksum in the background, paced, and reports damage: weekly, monthly, every <n>d, or off.

verify_rate.label: Check speed
verify_rate.help: The most the check reads a second (20M, 50M, 100M), so clients keep the disks.

hint.verify_rate: a size a second, 1M or more

restart.label: Apply the changes
restart.goLabel: Restart lanstash to apply the changes
restart.back: lanstash is restarting; it is back in a few seconds and this page with it.
restart.applies: Changes apply when lanstash restarts: a few seconds; prefills and downloads are cut off.
